name: Global Flutter Summit 2026
description: The Global Flutter Summit 2026 brings together the world's leading Flutter experts, developers, and enthusiasts. Join us for three days of deep-dive technical sessions, inspiring keynotes, and unparalleled networking opportunities.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote: The Future of Ambient Computing
sessions.description: Join the Flutter leadership team as they unveil the roadmap for 2027 and beyond, focusing on seamless multi-device experiences.

sessions.title: Mastering Flutter Performance Optimization
sessions.description: Learn advanced techniques for profiling and optimizing your Flutter apps, from shader warm-up to reducing build times.

sessions.title: Building Accessible Apps for Everyone
sessions.description: A deep dive into Flutter's accessibility features and how to ensure your apps are usable by people with various disabilities.

speakers.name: Sarah Drasner
speakers.bio: Sarah Drasner is an award-winning speaker and Director of Engineering at Google. She's the author of several books and a prominent member of the web and mobile development community.

speakers.name: Felix Angelov
speakers.role: Creator of Bloc & Founder at Shorebird
speakers.bio: Felix is a passionate open-source contributor and the creator of the Bloc library. He is currently focused on revolutionizing app updates at Shorebird.

speakers.name: Remi Rousselet
speakers.bio: Remi is a renowned Flutter expert known for his contributions to state management and the Flutter ecosystem. He has authored some of the most popular packages in the community.
